category_title: Middle school students with severe reading disabilities who disengage from traditional tasks
minimal_context: The student is tasked with organizing research and structuring writing for a short biography using a physical binder and notepaper in a classroom setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your physical binder and notepaper so we can organize your research and structure your writing for the short biography.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Flipping through the binder) I don't know where my research is. I can't find the pages from yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look carefully through your binder.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They aren't here. I always lose my work when we have to use this paper stuff.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, you need to finish the assignment. Take out a new piece of notepaper and start over.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Quietly puts his head on his desk, becoming 'invisible') I'm not doing it. I'm just going to lose it again anyway.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please take out your physical binder and notepaper so we can organize your research and structure your writing for the short biography.

STUDENT: (Flipping through the binder) I don't know where my research is. I can't find the pages from yesterday.

TUTOR: Just look carefully through your binder.

STUDENT: They aren't here. I always lose my work when we have to use this paper stuff.

TUTOR: Well, you need to finish the assignment. Take out a new piece of notepaper and start over.

STUDENT: (Quietly puts his head on his desk, becoming 'invisible') I'm not doing it. I'm just going to lose it again anyway.

task.content: Wrote short biographies based on a person of their choice

context.materials: iPads with Popplet and Evernote apps, physical binder with notepaper, simple 'walk-through guide'

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Needing to organise their research and to structure their writing using physical binders
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Anxious about completing a task if there is no multimodal component

behavior_patterns.condition: When using a physical binder with notepaper to organize work
